title: QuatIca: Advanced Numerical Linear Algebra and Optimization for Quaternionic Matrices in Python
summary: Quaternion-valued representations provide a convenient way to model coupled multi-channel signals (e.g., RGB imagery, polarization data, vector fields, and multi-detector time series). Yet practical and numerically reliable software support remains far less mature than those based on the real/complex setting. Here, we present QuatIca, an open-source Python library for quaternion numerical linear algebra and optimization, designed for both research prototyping and reproducible experimentation. QuatIca provides core quaternion matrix operations and norms; dense decompositions and reductions…
